status.en: 16 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Mogadishu, Puntland and Baidoa.
status.nb: 16 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Mogadishu, Puntland og Baidoa.

summary.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, while a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. The US and UAE carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia, and 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
